column1: # Only commands already confirmed, truly running in this repo, stand here. No
# invented passing check may stand: a missing check records as blocked, never as
# a line that always stays green.
# The static and positive layers give a fast cycle (near 30 seconds), integration
# adds the installer taking near six minutes. The full gate launches before round
# finalization, the fast one past every edit.
# No secrets may stand here: a command able to leak one never enters the gate.
# --- static: fast checks before every edit ---
# Five suites past moving obligations out of `server.py`: one test file per source.
# Each launches alone, because `python3 test_protocol.py` no longer runs neighbour
# module tests, and a silently excluded suite would read as green.
# The protocol row runs through the loader. `python3 <file> <file> ...` executes the
# FIRST file and passes the rest as argv, and ten of the eleven had no main block:
# the layer reported green while running nothing at all (backlog #68, fixed here
# on 2026-10-19 — the proof is a deliberately broken test turning the layer red).
